summary: Re-tested the public AccountEase preview for close-account behavior. MOCKED local React deletion, confirmation warning, cancel, desktop add-customer, print, and row navigation passed; mobile destructive-flow controls expose blocking layout/navigation issues. The supervised backend remains the starter FastAPI service and requested Spring routes are unavailable.

critical.issue: Public endpoint returns 404; the requested owner-scoped persistent deletion cannot be executed because Spring is not the active runtime.
All requested AccountEase routes return 404 on the supervised backend (regression suite 0/5).

ui_bugs.issue: Close account is fixed at the same bottom-right position as Add customer and intercepts its pointer events; Add customer cannot be opened at 390px width.
Breadcrumb back buttons are hidden on mobile and the mobile-back control is not visibly usable, leaving the user unable to return from the customer/ledger screens except by signing out.

integration_issues.issue: App stores one global customers array and renders it for every shop. Deleting customer 4 in shop 1 removes it from shop 2 as well, rather than only the current shop UI.
All login, customer, ledger, and delete actions use seeded React state with no REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL request. These flows are MOCKED and are not persistent or owner-authorized.

action_items: Deploy the Spring API (or implement equivalent routes in the supervised FastAPI service), including DELETE cascade and owner authorization.
Wire frontend auth and shop/customer/ledger state to REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
Partition frontend customer state by shop and verify deletion in one shop does not remove the customer from another.
Separate mobile Close account and Add customer fixed-action positions and expose a working mobile back control.
critical_code_review_comments: CloseAccountOverlay receives the same global customers state regardless of shop; the UI cannot satisfy current-shop-only deletion semantics.
The Java schema has ON DELETE CASCADE and the controller has an owner-scoped verification query, but this implementation is source-only and not running.
Mobile CSS gives .close-account-button and .fab identical right/bottom anchoring, causing pointer interception of a required action.

success_rate.frontend: approximately 70% of exercised flows; close-account core works but mobile controls and shop scope fail

seed_data_creation: No persistent data created. One temporary customer was created and deleted in MOCKED local React state during desktop testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview: https://customer-accounts-13.preview.emergentagent.com. Demo UI credentials rajesh/demo123 were supplied by the request; test_credentials.md is empty. Close-account modal, warning, selected deletion, and cancel were verified. Re-test mobile action placement, mobile back navigation, cross-shop deletion isolation, then API-backed DELETE with an owner token after Spring runtime deployment.
rca of the issue: Supervisor runs uvicorn backend/server.py, which exposes only starter status routes; ApiController.java is not compiled/launched. In App.js, initialCustomers is a single array passed to every Customers screen, so setCustomers filters it globally. Customers renders a fixed .fab at right:27px/bottom:28px while CloseAccountOverlay renders .close-account-button at right:28px/bottom:28px; at mobile width their boxes overlap and the close button intercepts Add customer. App.css hides .breadcrumb at max-width 760px, while the resulting mobile-back control is visually obscured by the header branding, leaving no usable return path.
